verdict.rationale: Clerk's first-party docs describe Organizations as the way to build multi-tenant B2B apps like Slack, Linear, and Vercel. Users can belong to multiple organizations, and each session carries the organization context: memberships, roles, and the active organization. Drop-in UI components let users create and switch organizations and view memberships and invitations, with default admin/member roles plus custom roles and permissions. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow itself (sending, accepting, revoking invitations), independent or hands-on corroboration of the organization and invitation features.
